entries.note: The pending.stale alert (modules/alerts/evaluator.ts) counts staged ROWS, and a screenshot set is a row per file; every other endpoint counts items (one per text, one per set). Count items, or say 'rows' in the alert text.

The cart lists one item per staged text; the pending view and summary fold all staged texts into ONE listing_text item (modules/publish/pending.ts itemsOf). The top bar and the sidebar badge show the cart count; a page built on the view shows another number.
Same split as pendingCount, plus the alert counting rows: cart 3 items, pending view 1 listing_text item, staged view 3, alert 3 rows. Only the pending view folds texts.

A pushed draft is a pending item (nextStep submit) in the view and the summary and is not in the cart: after the push the cart is empty and the summary still says 1. Same fact 'what waits for me', two definitions of 'waits'.
One text edited after a push: cart 1 (hash differs from the pushed hash), view and summary 2 (the unpushed text and the pushed draft that is still waiting for its submit).

The pending.stale alert asks pushed_at IS NULL, every other endpoint asks pushed_hash <> value_hash: a text edited after its push is unpushed for four of them and 'pushed' for the alert (which also has no way to see it).
After a push whose submit was blocked: the cart is empty (all pushed), the view and the summary count the pushed draft that waits for its submit. See pushed-draft.

lastPublish keeps the blockers of the moment the run was blocked (no_build) and shows them until the next run; readiness reads the store now and says nothing stands in the way. Pages that show the kept blockers after the cause was fixed are stale (docs/api/pending.md 'Why a publish failed').
